prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium three-dimensional INVISIBLE-MANNEQUIN FRONT product photograph of the Black WB0025 high-rise leggings. Image 1 is the exact garment reference for cut, high wide waistband, curved waistband seam, unprinted front, smooth nylon/spandex knit and flat ankle hems. Image 2 is a fit reference only: use the leggings' natural fitted shape on the wearer, without including the person or any other garment. Present the leggings ALONE, filled out exactly as if being worn by an invisible athletic model: rounded waistband and hip volume, softly shaped thighs, knees and calves, realistic fabric tension and a few subtle natural knee creases. Relaxed standing stance with one knee gently relaxed and a slight offset between the two legs. Waistband opening has a believable elliptical rim and natural interior depth. Keep the garment's actual seams and proportions, matte performance-knit texture and true black color. Clean front view with slight photographic depth, no added design details, logos, pockets, stripes, drawstrings or ribbed cuffs. No visible person, skin, mannequin parts, torso, feet, shoes or bra. Float the complete pair just above a soft diffuse oval shadow on a light neutral-gray seamless studio background, using soft side lighting to show fabric volume clearly. Portrait 1024x1536. Entire waistband and both hems visible, product fills about 85 percent of image height, generous margins and consistent premium catalog framing. One photograph, no text or watermark.
